annotations.title: Find games by genre, platform and price

description: Find paid games by genre, platform and highest price, most popular and best rated first. Use it for open requests such as "a strategy game under 20 on PC"; to look up a named game use search_games, for free games list_free_to_play, and for the biggest discounts list_deals. Every filter is optional and they combine: `genre` is a Steam genre, `platform` pc, xbox, playstation or switch, and `max_price` is in the currency `country` sets (20 means 20 GBP for gb), met by an in-stock key's listed price. The ranking weights Steam's share of positive reviews by review count, games with 500 reviews or more ahead of the rest; no match gives an empty list. Links go through getcheapgames.com and carry the stores' partner tracking; listed prices exclude the service fee marketplaces add at checkout.

country.description: Two-letter market code, any case, e.g. de, gb, us, br or pl (40 markets). It decides the currency prices come back in, which keys count as region-locked, and the market every link opens in. Omitted or unsupported codes fall back to ie (Ireland, euro).

genre.description: A Steam genre, spelled as Steam spells it: Action, Adventure, Casual, Indie, Massively Multiplayer, Racing, RPG, Simulation, Sports or Strategy. Any other value matches nothing.

max_price.description: The highest listed price, in the currency of `country` (e.g. 20 means 20 EUR for ie, 20 GBP for gb).

platform.description: Only keys for this platform: pc, xbox, playstation or switch. Omit for all.

name: find_games

bestListedPrice.description: The cheapest in-stock price of a key that activates in the market.

bestMayNotActivateHere.description: True when every key is region-locked for the market, so bestListedPrice is a locked key's.

buyUrl.description: Redirect through getcheapgames.com to the cheapest in-stock key.

pricesByPlatform.description: Lowest price per platform, e.g. {"PC": "19.99 EUR"}.

slug.description: The game's id, for its offers.

thirtyDayLow.description: A decimal amount such as 19.99, in the game's `currency`.
